    </table><h2 style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:10pt;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">A description of the Fund's valuation process is included under </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Valuation"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> within </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Item 1(c). Description of Business"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Calculation of NAV"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> within </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Item 9. Market Price and Dividends on the Registrant's Common Equity and Related Unitholder Matters"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of the Fund's </span><a href="https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2096330/000119312526057161/cvc_pef_form_10_amendmen.htm"><span style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Amendment No. 1 to the Registration Statement on Form 10</span></a><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") on February 18, 2026.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></h2><h2 style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:10pt;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Transactional NAV is based on the month-end fair values of all assets of the Fund less the liabilities of the Fund and all fees attributable to the Fund, including servicing fees, the management fee, the incentive allocation, distributions entitlement and other fees and expenses, in all cases as determined in accordance with the Fund's valuation policy that has been approved by the Fund's board of directors. During the one-year period beginning on April 1, 2026 (the "Expense Support Period"), CVC Advisors (U.S.) Inc., the Fund's investment adviser (the "Investment Adviser") has agreed to limit the amount of Specified Expenses borne by the Fund to the amount stated in the Investment Advisory Agreement, on an annualized basis, of our Transactional NAV as of the end of each calendar month (such limit, the "Expense Limitation" and such payment by the Investment Adviser, the "Expense Support"). The Expense Support Period may be renewed by the Investment Adviser in its sole discretion. To the extent that, as of the end of a given calendar month during the Expense Support Period, the Specified Expenses (annualized) exceed the Expense Limitation calculated as of the end of such calendar month, the Investment Adviser will pay, absorb or reimburse the Fund the amount of such excess or forgo its Management Fee in the amount of such excess. The definition of Specified Expenses is included in </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Note 4. Commitments and Contingencies"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> within </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Notes to Consolidated Financial Statement"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> in </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">"Part I. Item 1. Financial Statement"</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of the Fund's </span><a href="https://www.sec.gov/ix?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/0002096330/000119312526223103/cvc-20260331.htm"><span style="color:#0000ff;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q</span></a><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, filed with the SEC on May 14, 2026.</span></h2></div></div>

  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.5in;width:7.5in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.5in;"><h2 style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:10pt;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For purposes of calculating the Fund's Transactional NAV, (i) the Expense Support paid by the Investment Adviser will be recognized as a reduction to NAV in the month the Fund reimburses the Investment Adviser for such costs, (ii) servicing fees, as applicable, are recognized as a reduction to NAV on a monthly basis as such fees are paid and (iii) contingent tax liabilities of certain intermediate entities that are not expected to be recognized due to the expected structure of the divestment of the associated underlying investment may not be recognized as a reduction to NAV (although tax liabilities of those same intermediate entities may be taken into account in determining the fair value of the associated underlying investment). Transactional NAV per Unit may differ from the Fund's net asset value as determined with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America.</span></h2></div></div>
